parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.tickets (
    requester_email,
    requester_area,
    title,
    description
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
RETURNING
    id,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, ticket: { id: $json.id, status: $json.status, created_at: $json.created_at, updated_at: $json.updated_at } } }}
={{ { success: false, error: { code: 'TICKET_PERSISTENCE_ERROR', message: 'Unable to create ticket' } } }}
